author: macwiatrak
description:
Dataset for operon identification from long-read RNA sequencing
	

A dataset of annotated operons across 5 distinct bacterial strains. The operons were annotated by running and analysing long-read RNA sequencing and identifying genes
located on the same transcripts.
The genome protein sequences have been extracted from GenBank. Each row contains whole bacterial genome represented by an ordered list
of protein sequences.
